Emblem: a stylised black tree inside a green circle, with coloured leaves (blue and yellow at the top, white on the left, red on the right) and a green sphere at the root over a golden mound

Ink drawing: a crowned, bear-like creature with a globe-patterned belly standing on stylised waves and mountains, beneath a band showing a sun, a dark circle and a crescent moon; a wavy ornamental border frames the picture
Small circular seal containing a pentagram with an eye at its centre, surrounded by Avestan-like script characters
Large calligraphic S-like sigil with a dot, below the title
A line of Avestan-like script characters, framed by therefore-signs, above its transliteration
Small end-ornament: two overlapping mountain-peak strokes flanked by groups of dots

Nude figure lying on the left side, head resting on the left hand, right arm bent with hand on the ground, right leg bent with heel on the left knee; a sun face at the feet sends wavy rays along the body to the head. Caption: Sun Breath Posture
Standing male figure, front view, with circled numbers 1-4 marking body zones; head in profile with circled numbers 2, 3, 4, 1; head from behind with circled numbers 1, 3, 2, 4

Two seated male figures on stools (I front view, II profile gazing at a radiating sun/spot at eye level) and a hand with fingers slightly spread (III); caption: Correct posture for the First Master Arcane [Exercize]
Two standing male figures: front view with arms at sides, and profile view with one foot forward gazing at a radiating sun at eye level (dotted line from eyes to sun)
Seated nude male figure with legs straight out, bending forward and gripping the great toes with both hands; caption: Exercise of pulling the great toes, legs should be straight and so the arms

Three seated male figures on stools: I front view; II profile with eyes on a radiating sun at eye level (dotted line); III profile bent forward with eyes on a spot on the floor (dotted line); labelled I, II, III

First part of the Fourth Master Arcane: A front view of a standing figure, feet spread, with the rotating arm drawn in successive positions I-V describing a circle above the eyes and the other arm relaxed (VI, VII); B profile view with hand raised above the eyes; radiating sun at eye level joined by dotted lines to both figures' eyes

Second part of the Fourth Master Arcane: A front view of a standing figure, feet spread (IV, V), arm raised full length over the shoulder with clenched fist in successive positions I, II, III, radiating sun at eye level; B figure bent forward striking the earth in front of the feet with the fist (I)
Decorative divider: a black sigil/glyph flanked by black dots, between two rules

Front view of a standing male figure with arms extended sideways and (superimposed) folded on the breast; a black sun/spot with rays at eye level joined by dashed sight-lines; a second figure in profile with one arm extended and one folded on the breast
Decorative divider: a small black sigil/glyph flanked by black dots
Small sketch of a figure kneeling behind a chair with upright back-poles, and two small marks showing feet at an angle (^ and /\ with a dot)
Profile view of a figure kneeling on the ground, balancing on the balls of the feet, grasping two upright bamboo staffs held in front

Profile of a standing figure with hands placed on a stand/altar, a rayed sun with a face at upper left joined to the eyes by a dashed line; at right a separate drawing of two hands with fingers spread fan-like, thumbs and forefingers touching, captioned 'Position of hands'
Decorative divider: a small black sigil/glyph flanked by black dots, between two rules

Anatomical drawing: coronal section of the nasal fossae seen from behind, with labels for superior, middle and inferior turbinates (left) and superior, middle and inferior meatus (right) joined by dashed leader lines
Profile of a human head divided by lines into zones (forehead/top, face, back of head), captioned 'Currents of Ga-Ya-Lha-Ma charging the head'
Circle divided by a vertical line and a horizontal half-line into three sectors (the ancient representation of the Ga-Ya-Lha-Ma currents in the human head)

Two full-length standing figures: at left a naturalistic front-view male figure with the trunk divided into zones by curved lines; at right a schematic geometric figure (head as a rectangle, trunk divided into angular zones, tubular arms and legs)
Five-pointed star (pentagram) reversed white on a black circle, flanked by two columns of star epithets
Line of Avestan script (calligraphic) for Yat-Ha-Ah-Hu-Vai-Rio, ending with a therefore-sign
Line of Avestan script (calligraphic) for Yat-Ha-Ah-Hu-Vo, between therefore-signs
Seated male figure in profile, sitting erect on a cubic stool, hands on knees, shins forming a V; small circle (sun) above at left
Standing male figure in profile, erect, right foot forward; small circle (sun) above at left
Two bold hooked-cross symbols side by side: left labelled Souwastika, right labelled Swastika
Two hands side by side, each with index and middle finger extended and the other fingers folded (sacerdotal hand)
Heart outline containing a pentagram with an eye at its centre; labels Love (above), Al (left), Im (right), Peace (below)
Two standing nude male figures, hands pressed to the solar plexus: left with head bowed onto the chest, right with head raised
Separate drawing of two hands with fingers pointing toward each other (finger position on the solar plexus)

Sequence of eight drawings showing the pentagram traced stroke by stroke with direction arrows (First to Sixt motion, Complete, Complete with Zend mantram), plus two drawings of the right hand with index finger extended
Two lines of handwritten characters in an unidentified script (Caucasian/Georgian-like), each line flanked by ∴ / ∵ signs
One line of handwritten characters in an unidentified script (Caucasian/Georgian-like), with ∴ signs at both ends and after the first group
Seated figure leaning elbows on a table, head resting in the hands; caption 'Posture for hearing the Aum'
Face with eyes turned upward toward a dot between the eyebrows; below it a small drawing of a head resting on two hands with fingers over the ears; caption about position of the eyes
Glyph in unidentified script flanked by ∵ and ∴ signs, followed by a horizontal rule
Two drawings of clasped hands with forefingers raised: (1) posture of the hands; (2) the same with a composite third finger appearing between the forefingers; labels at right
Between two horizontal rules: drawing of a head seen from above resting between two hands, with a dot at the crown (urna/third eye); a divider before the next Arcane
Two empty musical staves (five-line staff with a clef mark), with a typed editorial note between them: the music for the mantras on pages 74 and 75 was not furnished with the manuscript
Two empty musical staves (five-line staffs), no notes written
Line of handwritten characters in an unidentified script following the closing quotation, flanked by ∵ and ∴ signs
Below a horizontal rule: a sun disc (left) and a crescent moon (right) above a winged sun disc (solar disc between two outstretched wings, with two serpent-like curves flanking the disc)
Horizontal cylinder (rod) drawn in outline; caption below: Grip from hardened coal (Sun)
Horizontal cylinder (rod) drawn in outline; caption below: Grip from hardened lodestone (Moon)
Two Egyptian-style male figures in profile, each holding a short rod in each hand: one standing (left), one seated on a block (right); ground line beneath
Drawing of a Tibetan dorgee (vajra/dorje) lying horizontally, with flame-like prongs at both ends; label below: DORGEE
Outline figure in prostration: kneeling, forehead and forearms on the ground, hips raised; two horizontal ground lines
Long thin tube drawn horizontally with dashed line showing the inner bore, rounded ends; caption: Form of tube used with this exercise

Ornamental emblem between two horizontal rules: a horizontal bar with X-shaped (hourglass) terminals at both ends and a central motif of two opposed crescents/forked shapes, resembling a stylised dorgee

Two drawings of cells side by side: left a rounded normal cell with nucleus and small inclusions, labelled 'Normal cell'; right a larger irregular cell full of dots and granules, labelled 'Cell expanded tru bad metabolism.'
Kneeling figure, upright on knees, arms raised straight overhead, swaying slightly backwards; ground line; caption beneath: First part of the XII Arcane
Figure prostrating on knees with forehead and forearms on the ground, hips raised; ground line; caption beneath: Second part of the XII Arcane

Two hands pressed together palm to palm with thumbs stretched apart (caption: Stretching and strenghtening the thumbs); a single open hand, back view, with fingers labelled Logic, Will, Destiny, Teacher, Humanity, Sex (caption: Meaning of the fingers)
Drawing of a flat wooden stick with rounded end, in perspective (caption: The form of the stick)
Chapter-head plate: three symbolic objects between rules — a hatched conical mound, a spiralling cup-like form on a stand (vortex/whirl), and a smooth dome/bell shape

Diagram of entire cavity of cerebro-spinal axis (ventricles seen from above with long central canal of spinal duct), and median section through the third and fourth ventricles of the brain (left half) with labelled parts; title: Diagrams of cavities and organs in the brain

Two hands held palms up with fingers bent so the backs of the fingers touch and thumb tips pressed together; back view of a head with the clasped hands placed at the nape of the neck (caption: Postures for the second exercise)
Profile of a head with three hatched circles marking areas of tension pressure: behind the point between the eyebrows, on the top of the head, and at the base of the skull
Three drawings of clasped hands: first position (right hand clasping left wrist), second position (right hand clasping outer side of left hand), third position (fingers of both hands hooked together)
Small glyph between two horizontal rules: a hook or spiral shape resembling a stylised 'U' with a curled tail (section divider)
Two small glyphs between horizontal rules: a symmetrical bracket-like figure with a small circle at top, and a hand/flower-like figure on a curled stem (section divider)
Three symbols in a row: a circle (sun), a hexagram (six-pointed star) inscribed in a circle, and a crescent moon
Tree with broad leaves above a horizontal ground line, its roots below the line wrapped around a circular seed/stone

Projection view from above: large circle (Earth) divided by radiating lines from centre N (north pole), sun drawn at top inside the circle, magical altar (1) and magical circle (2) drawn near the bottom; legend at right: 1 - magickal altar, 2 - magical circle, N - north pole
Profile of projection: dome-shaped arc of the Earth with N at the top, sun at upper right, altar (1) and circle (2) at the left edge, lines connecting them to N and the sun
Magical circle: a ring with a square inscribed inside; characters of a non-Latin script and small circles written around the ring
Magical wand drawn as a long thin rod with dashed line (magnetised wire) inside, N at the left end and S at the right end with a crystal tip
Triangle with a circle inscribed, dashed lines from the centre point of the circle to the three vertices; labelled at right 'Point of concentrative projection'
Cursive handwritten note in a different hand, diagonal, reading 'end' and 'breaks off'
